newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar lounges in range, no help from N.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar lounges in range, no help from N.

text.p: White sugar futures showed little inclination to do anything but tread water on Thursday as New York failed to kick the London market out of its recent lethargy, traders said.

A lacklustre performance on the raws market ensured that premium movements were limited, deterring sellers waiting at $69 and above on the May arbitrage and leaving London's nearby spreads trapped in a range.
"There's nothing happening -- New York's been stuck in a range for ages, London is in a range of $1.10," one trader said.
May and August attracted most dealing interest as usual but prices mostly hovered around their opening levels throughout the day.
At 1700 GMT May was down just 10 cents at $307.00 and August up 30 cents at $306.00. Volume reached 870 lots.
Movements in Paris were similarly meagre. May was 30 cents lower at $306.50 and August down 50 cents at $305.30.
Matif volume was an unimpressive 303 lots.
